analysis:
I examined the new Autopilot download, ledger, settings, model-set and start-inventory files and the telemetry-schema doc change. No supported regression was identified in this batch.

AutopilotDownload.swift:85-116 refuses a download unless the model is in the catalog, has a reportable ID, passes catalogAllows and has both r2Prefix and aggregateSHA256. It then checks the budget and uses the ordinary verified downloader (line 142). Errors collapse to closed refusal codes and details stay in the local log.

The disk guard fails closed when the free figure is unknown (line 44), and GiB conversion saturates. AutopilotDownloadSettings.swift:82-91 applies the caps with overflow checks. Downloads are enabled by default under saved consent (line 33). Whether the caller enforces consent, paused state and the enabled flag is not visible here. Integration must verify that the prefetch handler routes only consented, unpaused, enabled machines to this prefetcher; otherwise the coordinator should get model_not_selected.

The ledger (AutopilotDownloadLedger.swift) is operator-writable state. read() is bounded to 256 KiB and 256 entries and validates ID and hash. write() uses a 0600 staging file plus rename. Per StartInventory:85, a forged ledger entry can only keep a model whose local hash matches the recorded value in the set, and only when the catalog is unavailable. An operator who can replace weights already sits under T-012/T-027/ADV-001. The reported weightHash is still what the coordinator checks, so this is no new trust grant. That rests on the assumption that the coordinator verifies weight hashes independently.

isCurrentCatalogBuild (AutopilotModelSet.swift:81-86) accepts either the catalog weightHash or aggregateSHA256. Integration should confirm that WeightHasher output is only compared against the matching scheme, so a cross-scheme match cannot occur.

effective() caps the set at 256 entries. Persisted selections bypass the isReportableID check, as before.

The telemetry doc lines 65-72 add heartbeat Autopilot diagnostics (busy/stall reasons), described as closed vocabularies under consent. Their content was not verified here; the review should check transition_stalls for identifiers.

The callers (ProviderLoop prefetch dispatch, startAutopilotCandidateVerification, budget closure) and ModelDownloader verification were not supplied.
